chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Abdul Aziz ibn Hassan, from Zurara, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

Amir Al-Momineen (peace be upon him) said: 'The best of your dates are Al-Barny, therefore feed these to your womenfolk during their postpartum period, so that your children come out pure and forebearing.'

key_terms.الْبَرْنِيُّ: A specific variety of dates, considered superior in this context
key_terms.نِفَاسِهِنَّ: The postpartum period for women after childbirth

ai.seo_question: What is the recommended date for postpartum women according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in Al-Kafi by the prominent narrator Zurarah, this hadith links the specific quality of 'Al-Barny' dates to the spiritual and physical purity (zakiyyan) and temperament (haliyma) of offspring, reflecting the Shia emphasis on prophetic medicine. It underscores the practical application of dietary recommendations in nurturing both the mother’s recovery during nifas and the child’s innate disposition (fitrah).

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Abdul Aziz Bin Hassan, from Zurara, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdulllah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The best of your dates are Al-Barny, therefore feed these to your womenfolk during the childbirth, your children would come out a clever, forebearing’.
en.sarwar: 3. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from ‘Abd al-‘Aziz ibn Hassan from Zurarah who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that ’Amir al-Mu’minin, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
The best of your dates are al-Barniy, feed them to your women during their childbirth; your children will grow up intelligent and forbearing.’”
